summary.name: Chuttamalle Dance AI
summary.one_liner: An unofficial fan tool that turns an authorized adult portrait into a short (~15s, 9:16 vertical, 720p) AI-generated dance clip in a Chuttamalle-style template.
use_cases: Make a short vertical dance clip from a personal portrait for Reels or Shorts
Create a Chuttamalle-style AI meme edit
Animate an authorized adult photo into a dance-style video
Try a single-template dance edit before buying more credits
summary.what_it_does: The page describes uploading one authorized adult portrait (optionally a second) and generating a roughly 15-second 9:16 vertical dance clip at 720p using a single Chuttamalle dance template. Generation is described as generative character editing using TryAllAPI Wan 2.6 image-to-video, with Seedance as fallback when Wan is unavailable. The user can pick 3–10 second pacing, aspect and resolution before generating. Pricing is through one-time credit packs, with no subscription or sign-up required. The page states the tool is not a dedicated face-swap app and may alter face, hair, or clothing.
notable: Single template focus: one Chuttamalle dance lane rather than a large motion library
One-time credit packs ($8.88 single, $16.99 duo, $24.90 creator) with no subscription
Outputs labeled AI-assisted; limited to authorized adult (18+) portraits and original/AI or licensed audio
Failed renders return credits when generation is live
caveats: Unofficial fan tool, not affiliated with Devara, the artists, studio or label
Generative editing may change facial and clothing details; no guaranteed likeness accuracy and not a face-swap service
Paid credit packs required to generate; the sample clip is only a ~6s low-bitrate placeholder
Download links expire, so the MP4 must be saved promptly
